method: Per-layer multiset of complete positive-extrusion road records: start/end XY, own width, tool, object, feature, motion type, deposited E and layer height. Travel order and progress reports are excluded. Any arcs require separate review.
scope: Road multisets differ only in three inner-wall seams. Both seam placements retain a 0.06 mm seam gap; the maximum own-width bead-envelope difference is 0.002064 mm. All other deposition including supports, brims, outer walls and reviewed dense-region sample layers is identical. Travel ordering and M73 reports may differ.
